subject: ceri-dessie
label: The Blood Bond
to: Blood Bonded — married under Ceri's clan rite, with Ceri officiating
note: The BLOOD in Through Blood and Haven. Her clan is nomadic and blood-occult and marries by a rite with no officiant standing apart from the couple: they share blood with their chosen mate during intimacy, and the vow and the consummation are one act. Ceri performing her own marriage is not the strangeness it looks like — the only two people qualified to perform it were already in the room. Livi would have done a wedding. Ceri did a bond.
